demo.title: Chameleon UI inner demo
demo.kicker: Phase 1 internal — not the public docs site
demo.streetLead: Three decisions are waiting. Everything else can stay in the backlog.
demo.streetEmptyBody: Drop a folder when you are ready. Nothing is uploaded until you confirm.
demo.galleryLead: Official components, primitives, themes, and i18n. Theme switch sets data-theme; Arabic sets dir=rtl from language.
demo.adaptiveHint: Resize the browser: one Navigation landmark morphs from a tab bar to a sidebar. Layout follows window/container width — do not click to switch.
demo.alertBody: Status color comes from the active theme tokens.
demo.popoverBody: Popover content follows the document direction.
demo.threeEndLead: Not a token swap. One live AppShell + Navigation + Dialog filling the window. Drag the browser from about 390 → 768 → 1280 and the same components morph. Do not click to switch ends.
demo.threeEndCupertinoFrost: Cupertino is frosted glass, not a palette swap: nav bar, tab bar, and dialogs use saturate()+blur() over translucent fills. Open ?theme=cupertino to see the chrome.
demo.threeEndBannerPhone: Phone · nav=tab-bar form of Navigation · overlay=Dialog as bottom sheet · density=comfortable ≥44px
demo.threeEndBannerTablet: Tablet · nav=collapsible sidebar form of Navigation · overlay=centered Dialog · density=standard
demo.threeEndBannerDesktop: Desktop · nav=persistent sidebar form of Navigation · overlay=centered Dialog · density=compact
demo.threeEndNavPage: {label}. Compact pins the first four destinations and parks the rest behind More; tablet and desktop list every item in the same tree.
demo.threeEndNavDetailBody: {label} was pushed onto this tab's navigation stack. Back pops. Switching tabs does not push — it shows that tab's own stack.
demo.threeEndOverlayHint: One Dialog. Compact docks it as a bottom sheet; from 768px it centers. ActionSheet is a separate action-list component, not this morph.
demo.threeEndPointerNote: Pointer vs touch: hover styles apply only when (hover: hover). This machine hover={hover}, fine pointer={fine}. A virtual keyboard shrinks the viewport; keep inputs out from under a fixed tab bar.
demo.threeEndCollapseBody: Phones have no reliable hover, so the desktop hover Popover becomes click-to-expand here.
demo.threeEndVkbd: Virtual-keyboard trial (focus to raise the keyboard)
demo.threeEndResizeHint: Drag the window: ~390 Navigation tab-bar + Dialog sheet + 44px; ~768 collapsible sidebar; ~1280 persistent sidebar. Same component each time.
demo.threeEndFreezeSummary: Demo freeze (VR snapshots) — fixed iframe widths, not product behavior
demo.threeEndFreezeLead: The frames below freeze width at 390 / 768 / 1280 for visual-regression only. The product path is the full-window shell above, driven by window size.
demo.blindKicker: No theme name in chrome. Do not use DevTools.
demo.blindLead: You will see 16 screens (8 official homage themes × 2, shuffled). Pick which theme it is, or unknown. Correctness is not shown until the end. A session count is not a published recognition rate.
demo.blindStep2: Watch each AppShell + common-10 screen. Do not open DevTools or inspect data-theme.
demo.blindStep3: Pick one theme id or unknown, then Lock in guess. No reveal until the end.
demo.blindStep4: After 16 trials, Copy/Download JSON and hand it to the owner for ingest.
demo.blindAck: I will not use DevTools, view source, or peek data-theme during this session.
demo.blindDoneLead: This session counted {correct} of {total} correct. That number is not a published recognition rate. Do not type a fake percent into the kanban.
demo.blindHonesty: Export is a human session file only. Aggregate ≥5 independent humans via the operator kit before any ≥80% product claim.
demo.blindExportHint: Give this file to the owner. Ingest with pnpm blind:ingest. Never invent a percentage.
